name: Eddie Lee
biography: is a security researcher at Blackwing Intelligence. He specializes in application security, but is an enthusiast of all things related to security. From exploiting buffer overflows to building robots to messing with RFID, he just likes to figure out how things work (and how they break). Before Blackwing, Eddie was a member of the Security Research Group at Fortify software where he helped develop methods to detect vulnerabilities and attacks through static analysis and runtime analysis. Eddie has previously spoken at DEF CON and is a core member of Digital Revelation -- a two-time DEF CON CTF 1st place team
